answers.how: The paper width is approximately 131 px and the roll diameter is 155 px: 10 × 155/131.

A complete wall tile spans approximately 359 px horizontally: 10 × 359/131.
The tile height is approximately 238 px: 10 × 238/131.
Near 0.50 s, the roll moves approximately 44.5 px over 0.20 s. Converting using 10 cm per 131 px gives approximately 17 cm/s.
Near 1.00 s, the roll moves approximately 27 px over 0.20 s: (27/0.20) × 10/131.
The roll center travels approximately 139 px from 0.50 s to 1.50 s: (139/1.00) × 10/131.
